name: cruma
description: Install the Cruma tunnel agent and publish a dev server or a folder, with explicit approval. Needs a coding agent with a shell on your own computer; where the environment does not allow installing it, such as claude.ai chat's sandbox, it explains that. A skill only; it connects the MCP tools only after you say yes, and in Codex the cruma-local plugin bundles them.

interface.shortDescription: Share dev servers from your computer
interface.longDescription: Install the Cruma agent after you agree, and share a dev server or a folder after you approve making it public. Needs a coding agent with a shell on your own computer; in Codex, cruma-local also bundles the MCP tools.
defaultPrompt: Expose my dev server on port 3000.
